files.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one wide 3:2 editorial illustration for an academic reading edition about how ordinary employees share AI-assisted work methods. Primary request: depict a concrete everyday handover of a daily industry-news brief in a modest contemporary office. Two adult colleagues sit beside each other at a desk; one shows a working news digest on a laptop, the recipient compares a paper checklist and points to a different item she needs for her role. On the desk are a small stack of printed news pages, a pen and a coffee mug. The screens and papers contain abstract rows, small document symbols, dates as simple blank blocks, no readable words and no charts. Scene must show careful practical discussion, not celebration and not a futuristic technology demo. Style: refined editorial gouache and pencil illustration, restrained warm off-white, deep teal, muted sage and small terracotta accents, textured paper, convincing human gestures and anatomy, generous negative space around the people, clean professional composition, not a stock corporate cartoon. No robots, glowing brains, holograms, logos, brand names, text, speech bubbles, numbers, company identities or real named people. This is a fictional illustrative scene, not documentary evidence. Do not put any caption within the image. Opaque background.
